scripts.prebuild: npm run build -w @arcade/contracts && npm run build -w @arcade/service-auth && npm run build -w @arcade/observability
scripts.dev:services: concurrently -n identity,catalog,booking,payment,notification,inventory,analytics "npm run dev -w @arcade/identity-service" "npm run dev -w @arcade/catalog-service" "npm run dev -w @arcade/booking-service" "npm run dev -w @arcade/payment-service" "npm run dev -w @arcade/notification-service" "npm run dev -w @arcade/inventory-service" "npm run dev -w @arcade/analytics-service"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,gateway,services "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:gateway" "npm run dev:services"
scripts.pretypecheck: npm run build -w @arcade/contracts && npm run build -w @arcade/service-auth && npm run build -w @arcade/observability
scripts.pretest: npm run build -w @arcade/contracts && npm run build -w @arcade/service-auth && npm run build -w @arcade/observability
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:policies
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
